nd_convergence.reference: highest Nd evaluated (3001), same waveform, dt=1 ns, CUDA backend
nd_convergence.rule: Nd=1501 is accepted only if every case meets every tolerance vs the highest Nd AND the Nd=1501-vs-2001 difference is not larger than the 2001-vs-3001 difference by a trend that would carry 1501 outside tolerance. Otherwise STOP (technical blocker).
nd_convergence.additional: tau_atom must also be stable across Nd (relative change < 5%) or be reported as a quadrature artifact.

decisive_effect_rule: A dwell/ordering effect is only called real if |Delta_full| exceeds (i) 3x the numerical difference (dt 1->0.5 ns, Nd 1501->highest) for the same metric, and (ii) the paired 95% CI excludes 0 across >=4 (preferably 8) independent realizations; 'dynamic' requires |Delta_full - Delta_ctrl| CI excluding 0 for BOTH static and LTI+static controls.
